topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I sit here with the blueprint sprawled out before me, lines and notations marking the path to what I thought was a new dawn. Each sketch, each calculation, a testament to countless nights and days. But now, the paper from the office lays there, a cold whisper of reality. It speaks of another, someone who walked this same path and left their mark first. The tool I envisioned, it already bears another’s name. The air feels different now, thinner, as if the weight of what is already cast can barely allow for the new. Yet, the fire within hasn't dimmed. Paths are many; perhaps another will open.
